Hey @FernandVEYRIER just as a heads up, my expectation is that the flags are handled correctly:
```
{
    "isNew": boolean,
    "isModified": boolean,
    "preview": GitHubIssue,
    "full": GitHubIssue
}
```
`isNew` indicates that it has been added to the directory since you last viewed it on your client. There is a visual indicator of a bright cyan bar on the left side. 
`isModified` indicates that the issue specification has been modified since you last viewed it on your client. There WILL be a visual indicator of a bright orange bar on the left side. 
---
Both have been implemented poorly, but I imagine that once this code is refactored those could be straightforward to check for.

This seems like a good idea because our sync on the backend is every 15 minutes. 
Although at the risk of over engineering: I'm curious if these parameters are optimal.
